tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground: shallow water in light, night water in dark. Behind feeds, forms and the album page.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, the bottom bar, inputs at rest.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Pressed and hovered quiet controls, neutral chips, wells inside a card.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines and dividers. Decorative only: never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders that carry meaning: inputs, the secondary button, the empty fishing line. 3:1 on surface in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on bg, surface, surface-sunken, water-soft, gold-soft and paper.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and metadata on bg, surface, surface-sunken, water-soft, gold-soft and paper.

tokens.name: water
tokens.usage: The brand's water blue. Links, the active tab, text actions, selected states; as text on bg, surface, surface-sunken, water-soft and paper.

tokens.name: water-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted background behind water text: your own ranking row, avatars without a photo, hover on text actions.

tokens.name: on-water
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a water fill.

tokens.name: bobber
tokens.usage: The bobber red. The one primary action per view (Registrar peixe, Salvar), the Log button in the bottom bar, the logo's top half. Never for errors alone.

tokens.name: bobber-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill of the primary button.

tokens.name: bobber-text
tokens.usage: Small red text: destructive actions, form errors, a reaction you gave. On bg, surface and bobber-soft.

tokens.name: bobber-soft
tokens.usage: Background behind bobber-text: error notes, the bait tip category.

tokens.name: on-bobber
tokens.usage: Label and icon on a bobber or bobber-hover fill. Dark in the dark theme, because white fails on the lighter red.

tokens.name: reed
tokens.usage: Reed green. Released fish, success, the protected-species badge, the recipe tip category; as text on surface, reed-soft and paper.

tokens.name: reed-soft
tokens.usage: Background behind reed text.

tokens.name: on-reed
tokens.usage: Text on a reed fill.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Awards only: first place, a new sticker, promotions, official challenges, Fish of the Month. A fill, never text.

tokens.name: gold-text
tokens.usage: Gold as text and icons on surface and gold-soft: your challenge position, the level label.

tokens.name: gold-soft
tokens.usage: Background of the promotion banner and award notes.

tokens.name: on-gold
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a gold fill, in both themes.

tokens.name: podium-silver
tokens.usage: Second place marker in rankings.

tokens.name: podium-bronze
tokens.usage: Third place marker in rankings.

tokens.name: on-podium
tokens.usage: The position number on podium-silver and podium-bronze, in both themes.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: The album page: warm sticker-album paper behind the stickers.

tokens.name: paper-ink
tokens.usage: Text printed on paper: species names in empty slots, album headings.

tokens.name: paper-line
tokens.usage: The dashed outline of an empty sticker slot and the large question mark in it. 3:1 on paper; not for small text.

tokens.name: rarity-comum
tokens.usage: Comum tier: sticker frame and badge text on surface and paper. Tiers differ by hue, so the tier name always shows beside the color.

tokens.name: rarity-incomum
tokens.usage: Incomum tier: sticker frame and badge text. An alias of reed.

tokens.name: rarity-raro
tokens.usage: Raro tier: sticker frame and badge text. An alias of water.

tokens.name: rarity-epico
tokens.usage: Épico tier: sticker frame and badge text on surface and paper.

tokens.name: mark-cream
tokens.usage: The logo bobber's light half and stem. Fixed in both themes so the bobber always reads.

tokens.name: mark-band
tokens.usage: The dark band across the logo bobber. Fixed in both themes.

tokens.name: sea-shallow
tokens.usage: Sea moments (reward screen, onboarding, empty states) and the photo placeholder.

tokens.name: sea-deep
tokens.usage: Fish silhouettes and depth in sea moments, on sea-shallow (3:1 graphic contrast).

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim over photos behind white text.

tokens.name: on-overlay
tokens.usage: Text and icons on overlay.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline links. An alias of water.

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Big Shoulders Display, from Google Fonts: condensed and bold like sticker-album lettering and scoreboards. Numbers, names and titles only, never running text.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Reward moments only: XP gained, a new sticker, a promotion.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Species names on catch cards, challenge titles, section headings.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: Numbers people compare: XP, ranking positions, counts. Always tabular figures.

styles.name: sticker-no
styles.usage: The number printed on album stickers and empty slots.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Atkinson Hyperlegible, from Google Fonts: designed for low-vision legibility, which also helps on a phone in sunlight at the water's edge.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Card headings, people's names, list titles.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Saiu na terceira arremessada, com isca artificial, perto da galhada.
styles.usage: Stories, tips, comments, everything people read.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Uppercase labels: rarity badges, tab labels, eyebrow text. The smallest size in the product.

spacing.note: 4px base. Use gap on flex and grid rows instead of margins.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label inside small badges.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Icon to label in buttons; gap between buttons in a group.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between related rows: avatar and name, list items.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding and the page's side gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding of buttons.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between blocks inside a screen.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between sections.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Around sea moments and empty states.

radius.note: Soft and rounded, like river stones. Buttons and chips are pills.

tokens.name: radius-sticker
tokens.usage: Album stickers and empty slots: the slightly rounded corner of a die-cut sticker.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, photo thumbnails, nav hit areas.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, ranking rows, menus.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Sheets, the album page, banners.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, badges, avatars.

size.note: Fixed measures the layout relies on.

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: Minimum height and width of anything tappable.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Width of the main column on every screen.

tokens.name: sticker-w
tokens.usage: Album sticker width on phones; height follows a 3:4 ratio.

shadow.note: Flat by default. Cards get a hairline lift; only things that float get a real shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Cards and ranking rows at rest.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: The Log button, menus, toasts, the reward sheet.

tokens.name: shadow-sticker
tokens.usage: A sticker sitting on the album page.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on every control: a 2px gap, then 2px of solid water blue (at least 6:1 on surface and bg).
